# vendor/

Pinned copies, per the series rule "copy, don't link". Never edited in place.

- `evidence_kit/`: evidence-kit 3.6.0 (the reading template, Medium skin and components used by `tools/build_docs.py`), copied from `../ai_control_plane/vendor/evidence_kit` on 2026-10-07.
- `kit4/`: evidence-kit 4.1.0, the Lab Console renderer (`tools/build_lab_console.py`), copied from `../ai_control_plane/vendor/kit4` on 2026-10-07.
- `kit5/`: evidence-kit 5.2.0, the pae-proof/v1 proof pack (`tools/proof_pack.py`, `tools/verify_evidence.py`) and the publication path scan, copied from `../ai_control_plane/vendor/kit5` on 2026-10-07.

`../runner/experiment_runner/` is experiment-runner 1.1.0 (copied from `../experiment-runner/experiment_runner` on 2026-10-07); the real-model slice uses its `ollama.connect`.
